RETROSPECTIVE ARCHITECTURE DECISION · 11 OCTOBER 2026

ADR-0008: Audit evidence and OpenTelemetry are distinct

Status

Accepted; regional SQL audit and OTel wiring implemented

Context

Sampled traces cannot provide a complete or immutable record of sovereignty decisions.

Decision

Keep audit intents in the local business/control transaction and instrument flows with OpenTelemetry. Use bounded metric dimensions and regional telemetry routing; do not export customer payloads into global diagnostics.

Alternatives

Use traces as the audit trail; centralize raw payload logs worldwide.

Consequences

The lab's SQL audit and recent UI events are not immutable bank evidence. Regional append-only relay, retention and access controls are pilot work. The local collector uses a debug exporter.

Evidence

poc/app.py; poc/otel-collector.yaml; poc/migration.py

Gate

Observe Collector receipt and local traces; separately prove audit completeness, retention and no forbidden telemetry.
